title: The hedgerow hunter
body: A rust-coloured hunter with a white-tipped tail slips through the hedgerows at dusk and pounces on voles.

title: Life in the pack
body: A canine hunter of the far north travels in packs and communicates with long calls at night.

title: Mans best friend
body: Loyal companions that have lived beside people for thousands of years and guard homes and herd sheep.

title: Winter sleepers of the mountains
body: Huge shaggy mammals that eat berries and fish all summer and then sleep through the cold months in a den.

title: Antlers in the mist
body: Graceful grazers with branching antlers move through the misty valley at first light.

title: Silent flyers of the night
body: A bird with large round eyes and a flat face turns its head almost all the way around to find prey in the dark.

title: Why do pets purr
body: Small pets with whiskers purr when they feel safe and they always land on their feet.

title: Animals of the forest
body: Many animals live in the forest and each finds food in its own way.

title: The fox that was mistaken for a wolf
body: Villagers feared a wolf but the animal was a small fox hunting mice.
